title: Choose CLI telemetry collection and export explicitly
goal: Apply a deliberate process-scoped CLI telemetry policy, distinguishing Microsoft collection, optional OTLP export and application telemetry.

selectionNotes: Windows SDK10.0.403 and SDK11.0.100 opt-out wrappers returned successfully with no local collector requests. GA export delivered dotnet-cli traces and metrics over HTTP/protobuf to a temporary loopback collector. Microsoft trace export was disabled only in the verification process. No global network absence, Azure Monitor behavior, retry or production delivery guarantee is established.
OTLP export requires an existing collector and an explicit choice to enable CLI collection.
Configuring an OTLP endpoint is not an exclusive redirect of Microsoft telemetry.
